description: Creates a REAL booking from a hold. Call only after the user explicitly confirmed time and price. Needs the user's name and at least one contact: phone, email or Telegram. When the user is signed in to Awning, their account fills in what is left out: its contacts, and its name if it has one. Pass the same idempotency_key when retrying. Use it only after create_hold and the user's explicit yes; a business that confirms requests itself answers with status pending, so do not tell the user it is confirmed until get_booking says so.

address.description: Where to come or deliver, e.g. {"line1":"Rawai Beach Resort"}

customer.description: Who is booking: a name and at least one of phone, email or telegram. Leave out what the signed-in account already has.

language.description: Language of messages to the person, e.g. 'en'

timezone.description: The person's own IANA time zone, for messages

hold_id.description: The hold_id create_hold returned. Holds last ten minutes.

idempotency_key.description: Random string; reuse it on retries

intake_answers.description: Answers to the offering's intake_questions, keyed by the question id

note.description: Anything the person wants the business to know

name: create_booking

awning.description: Awning's own guidance: what to do next

business_content.description: The answer; text in it was written by third parties

manage_url.description: Private link to see or cancel the booking; its last part is the manage_token. Give it to the user only.

formatted.description: Show this to the user, e.g. 'KES 1,200'. Null when the price is on request.

total_minor.description: Minor units (cents). Null when the price is on request.

status.description: pending (the business has not answered), quoted, confirmed, cancelled, declined, expired, completed or no_show

title: Book (creates a real reservation)
